title: Solutions Architect
description: About Plane Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together. Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship. Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules. Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work. Humans and agents We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's. Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives. This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that. About the role Our largest customers do not buy Plane off the shelf. A bank wants it behind their firewall with SSO tied to their identity provider; a defense contractor wants it air-gapped with a migration plan from three legacy tools at once. You will own the technical architecture for these deployments before the contract is signed and after, translating what a customer's infrastructure and compliance team requires into a Plane deployment that actually holds up. You will work directly with sales on the largest deals we run and with engineering when a customer's requirements push past what we support today. This role exists because our regulated-industry customers ask questions our sales team cannot answer alone, and our engineers should not have to answer on every call. What you'll do Own the technical architecture for enterprise and regulated-industry deployments, from the first discovery call through a signed statement of work. Design self-hosted and air-gapped Plane deployments that satisfy a specific customer's security review, not a generic best-practice checklist. Run technical discovery with customers whose infrastructure and compliance teams will pick apart every answer you give, and be right often enough that they trust the next one. Define the migration path when a customer moves off two or three existing tools at once, including what data does not survive the move and saying so up front. Work daily with sales on live deals and with engineering when a customer's requirements expose a real gap in the product, carrying that gap back as a specific, scoped request rather than a vague one. Answer the same security questionnaire in a slightly different format for the fourth time this month, because every regulated buyer's procurement process is its own small bureaucracy and none of them read each other's paperwork. What you'll bring You have designed and defended a technical architecture to a skeptical buyer , and you can walk us through one deal where the customer's own security or infrastructure team changed your design. You understand self-hosted and on-premises deployment beyond a docker-compose file , including networking, SSO and identity federation, and what changes when a customer runs the software instead of you. You can read a security questionnaire or compliance requirement and translate it into an actual deployment decision , not a reassurance. You are comfortable being the technical voice on a sales call , including the parts where the answer is no or not yet. You write technical documentation a customer's own engineers will actually follow , because you will not be in the room when they run it. Nice to haves You have worked pre-sales or post-sales in a solutions architecture, sales engineering, or technical account management role selling to regulated industries. You have contributed to Plane, run it self-hosted, or maintained another open project people rely on. You have shipped or supported deployments into banking, defense, healthcare, or air-gapped environments specifically. You have opinions about how AI agents should be permissioned and audited in an enterprise environment, and can defend them. Tech Backend : Python/Django, Golang, Node.js, Postgres, Redis Messaging : RabbitMQ, Kafka Infrastructure : AWS, Kubernetes, Rancher, self-hosted deployment via Docker and Helm Identity : SAML, OIDC, SCIM Everyday tools : GitHub, Plane (yes, we run on it), Figma, Slack Why Plane? Every company says it is different. We will try evidence instead. The scope is real. We are a passion team serving companies of every size, including some of the largest in the world. Something you ship this month will run inside a Fortune 500 company and a 50-person startup in the same week, and you will hear from both. The constraints make you better. Plane runs in our cloud, in customers' clouds, and on machines that will never touch the internet. Much of the work happens in the open, where the issues, the fixes, and the roadmap conversations are public. Building software that survives all of that is harder than building an ordinary SaaS product, and it is a better education than most companies can offer. The people-and-agents future is being built here, in production. We think humans and AI agents will share one system of action for work. We are building that system now, for customers who already depend on it, and you will work on that problem directly whatever your role. Your name is on the work. The teams are deeply connected enough that credit and responsibility both find you fast. That is some pressure. Mostly it is the fun part. If that sounds like your kind of place, we would like to meet you. Plane is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. Everything before it (multiple parties, several legal documents, opposing interests, a redlining process most companies still run through email attachments) is where contracting actually gets hard. Form your own view of the jobs to be done rather than inheriting ours. You've built for users you got to know directly, not through Sales or Customer Success. That means you've sat with them, watched them work and can tell us what they taught you. title: Senior Financial Reporting Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 London/Distrubuted across the UK | 💰£56,000 - £75,000 (depending on experience) ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance |<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a> |<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4"> Hear from the team</a> ✨</p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Finance team</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a highly proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded Financial Reporting Senior Analyst to join our Financial Reporting team, and help us build a world-class finance function.</p> <p>We have some really exciting challenges coming up, like expanding into the European Union, introducing Monzo Mobile and Habito to our group, climate change reporting, continuing to grow our customer base, expanding our lending business, and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way while helping us optimize our financial reporting processes with the help of technology. You’ll join the Finance team and report to our Financial Reporting Manager.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Supporting the full year end process, from drafting the annual report to working with external auditors until final sign-off. </li> <li>Supporting tight processes with our internal finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process.</li> <li>Understanding the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.</li> <li>Working with our engineers and data teams to automate the production elements of the role, allowing you to focus on the parts of the role where your knowledge and skills provide the most value.</li> <li>Understanding our accounting system and making sure we are taking advantage of all its features to minimise manual elements of reporting.</li> <li>Being responsible for ensuring our financial reporting policies, procedures and controls are up to date, relevant and useful for Monzo and importantly are scalable.</li> <li>Reviewing new products and the impact of new contracts, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.</li> <li>Working with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.</li> <li>Maintaining existing and developing new controls that protect our financial data and our balance sheet substantiation process.</li> <li>Supporting the production of ESG sustainability reporting and disclosures.</li> <li>Preparing monthly management and ad hoc reports, offering meaningful analysis of movements.</li> <li>Resolving miscellaneous inquiries and supporting the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers and tax policy research!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified chartered accountant (ACA or CA) and ideally have audit experience combined with some financial reporting and control experience outside of practice. </li> <li>You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls.</li> <li>You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors.</li> <li>You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds.</li> <li>You’re comfortable with leveraging data to automate reporting and drive efficiency (SQL skills would be a bonus).</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment.</li> <li>Nice to have:</li> <ul> <li>Experience in a listed company or financial services regulated environment. </li> <li>Strong business partnering/commercial financial acumen. </li> <li>ESG reporting/audit of sustainability information (carbon footprint, CFD/CSRD).</li> </ul> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰£56,000 - £75,000 (depending on experience) ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role is based in our London office and we aim to come in as a team twice a week. We're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) if required.</p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Screening Conversation </li> <li>Initial Hiring Manager Interview (30 Minutes) </li> <li>Role Specific Interview (60 Minutes) </li> <li>Behavioural Interview (45 Minutes)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Business Director, Biddable
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>1812 - Business Director, Biddable</strong></p> <p><strong>About WPP 650</strong></p> <p>Join an award-winning team at the heart of UK government, where your work will genuinely shape lives. As part of WPP 650 you’ll be part of a supportive, collaborative environment that values curiosity, kindness, and growth. Together, we use behaviour change principles to design smarter services, influence better decisions, and help millions of people across the country.</p> <p>Named WPP 650, after the 650 UK parliamentary constituencies, the name is a reminder that our work must reflect the full breadth of the country, every community, every audience. No two days are the same. The challenges are complex, the problems worth solving, and the learning constant. You’ll tackle issues that matter, alongside talented colleagues who care deeply about what they do. It’s demanding – but always rewarding.</p> <p>This is meaningful work with real-world impact – the kind you can point to with pride.</p> <p>Role Summary and Impact</p> <p>As a <strong>Biddable Director</strong>, you will provide strategic leadership within the Media Activation team, driving excellence across both Paid Search and Paid Social for key clients. This leadership role delivers category-defining capabilities and services across biddable media, ensuring optimal campaign performance and maximizing in-channel effectiveness and data integrity across all relevant platforms. You will lead and develop Biddable activation teams, cultivate strong client and supplier relationships, and define advanced Biddable strategies that align with business objectives and drive growth. Your expertise will provide rigorous and innovative recommendations across both Paid Search and Paid Social, ensuring continuous optimization and adherence to best practices, and strategically weaving Biddable into overall cross-channel campaign strategies within the WPP Open ecosystem.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Line Management:</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and development to direct Biddable activation teams (including Account Managers and Account Executives), fostering excellence and professional growth. Support capacity planning and resource management, leading recruitment for your immediate team and assisting with wider team recruitment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strategic Biddable Leadership:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and lead advanced Biddable strategies for client portfolios, ensuring clear alignment with business objectives, KPIs, and industry context across both Paid Search and Paid Social.</li> <li>Provide strategic insight for client product areas within Biddable media, and proactively spot trends, product releases, and opportunities to enhance activity.</li> <li>Oversee the development and creation of Biddable best practices, with ultimate accountability for adherence to controls and effective oversight of designated campaigns.</li> <li>Develop thought leadership pieces and case studies to galvanize the role of Biddable within the wider media community.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Client & Partner Relationship Management:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop strong relationships with key clients and suppliers, leading team communications with these stakeholders and providing useful insight independently.</li> <li>Lead efforts to gather and disseminate client intelligence to understand and meet their business needs, navigating critical business changes and complex issues.</li> <li>Manage team members to deliver consistently across multiple Paid Search and Paid Social campaigns.</li> <li>Act as a key biddable point-of-contact for clients, maintaining their confidence in the team's output.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Operational Excellence & Innovation:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Oversee operational excellence, including financial accuracy, data integrity, and end-to-end campaign management processes across Biddable channels.</li> <li>Act as an escalation point for activation issues, troubleshooting, and resolving conflicts between best practice and client requirements.</li> <li>Drive innovation by building annual learning agendas and comprehensive test plans for assigned portfolios, fostering continuous optimization.</li> <li>Contribute to agency-wide continuous improvement projects regarding processes and quality standards.</li> <li>Lead through vision, values, and model leadership behaviours while championing and facilitating change.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Commercial Acumen:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrate strong commercial acumen, leading on the delivery of services in line with client objectives, service level agreements, and terms of business.</li> <li>Develop ways of working that maximise client output whilst minimizing operational input.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Deep Biddable Expertise:</strong> Extensive experience (e.g., 7+ years) in digital media, with specialization across both Paid Search (Google Ads, Bing Ads) and Paid Social (Meta Ads Manager, TikTok, Pinterest, etc.). Proven track record of driving performance for clients across biddable channels.</li> <li><strong>Platform Proficiency:</strong> Experience with planning and directly managing large-scale Paid Search (PPC) and Paid Social campaigns. Experience with Google stack and relevant certifications (e.g., Google Ads, Meta Blueprint) desirable.</li> <li><strong>Strategic & Analytical Acumen:</strong> Strong understanding of optimization levers & testing approaches. Excellent analytical skills (quantitative analysis) and proven critical thinking capability to interpret complex campaign data and derive actionable insights.</li> <li><strong>Leadership & People Management:</strong> Proven Project Management, Leadership, and People Management Experience, including responsibility for career development, managing people/teams, and leading hybrid teams (e.g., local teams or cross-functional teams).</li> <li><strong>Client & Stakeholder Management:</strong> Proven ability to build strong relationships with key clients and suppliers/vendors, leading team communications and driving workstreams independently. Experience in internal and external stakeholder relationship management.</li> <li><strong>Communication & Influence:</strong> Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex strategies and performance insights clearly and persuasively to diverse audiences. Self-starter who can proactively influence clients to help evolve best practices and drive innovation.</li> <li><strong>Integrated Perspective:</strong> Strong understanding of how Paid Search and Paid Social integrate into overall cross-channel campaign strategy and the wider media landscape.</li> <li><strong>Global Context:</strong> Desirable experience working in a global context to drive localization and adoption of biddable best practices and running campaigns across multiple countries/languages.</li> <li><strong>Mindset:</strong> Passion for biddable media, active interest and understanding of online advertising industry trends, and proactive in evolving best practices.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:</p> <p>Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.</p> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.</p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy</a>) for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX

You should fully understand their motivations and how to aid their development.  </p> <p>Some of the best things about this role </p> <ul> <li>Accountability of PRF delivery.</li> <li>Team management.</li> <li>Develop strategic thinking.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p><strong>Campaign Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Independently manage the assigned teams and implement media campaigns.</li> <li><span data-teams="true">Previous experience across print.</span></li> <li>Applies best practice to campaign management and acts as the escalation point for issues.</li> <li>Manages and takes ownership of campaigns from start to completion.</li> <li>Delivers accurate planning and reporting in line with strategic and commercial objectives. With value-add insights for the role of the medium as part of the overall campaign and smart use of campaign planning or market opportunities.</li> <li>Helps to drive new routes to optimum planning outputs and supports operational and planning strategies which support best in class delivery.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Media Investment Planning</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develops media plans with wider Commerce, Client, and Investment teams to meet the client’s business and brand objectives.</li> <li>Ensures that media plans are mirroring WM commercial deliverables.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Demonstrating Value</strong></p> <ul> <li>Provides guidance to others on specific strategies to identify client needs and expectations and address them effectively.</li> <li>Interprets planning data relative to the performance of products, services and solutions against client needs to ensure the customer recognizes and receives value, setting the right KPI's and metrics.</li> <li>Ensures that the product, innovation, service, and solutions are utilised that differentiate WPP Solutions from its competitors and demonstrate the value proposition of a continued partnership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Multitasking</strong></p> <ul> <li>Oversees team members to discuss current projects, workload and activities; prioritizes resources accordingly.</li> <li>Improves workload management by supporting others in setting priorities and by postponing less relevant work.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Operational Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ensure that the team are implementing best operational practice.</li> <li>Actively seeks opportunities to improve team output and to overcome barriers and ensures roll out.</li> <li>Checks that best practice is in place and any supporting training is taken.</li> </ul> <ul> <ul> <li>Flags any barriers to success to line manager.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. title: Staff Data Engineer - GTM
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2>What is the opportunity?</h2> <p>Every go-to-market decision at Intercom, who we target, who owns the account, what we know about them, what we should say next - rests on a foundation of account and contact data. Getting that foundation right is one of the highest-leverage engineering problems in the company: a single account hierarchy fix can re-route territory, pipeline credit and forecast for thousands of accounts at once.</p> <p>This role owns that foundation. You will build and run the systems that decide what an account <em>is</em>, resolving duplicates, stitching subsidiaries into corporate hierarchies, sourcing new accounts and contacts into our CRM, and enriching them with firmographic, technographic and intent signals. Increasingly using LLMs and web research rather than off-the-shelf vendors. Your work is used daily by Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Sales Ops and Finance, and directly shapes how efficiently Intercom grows.</p> <p>You will sit in the Data group and partner extremely closely with GTM Systems, RevOps and the frontline teams. This is a role for an engineer who wants to be <em>in</em> the business, not adjacent to it. Someone who gets energy from a rep saying "this list is exactly right" and from watching a pipeline they built turn into revenue.</p> <h2>What will I be doing?</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Owning account identity.</strong> Building and improving the entity-resolution layer that decides when two records are the same company: domain and firmographic matching, confidence scoring, and the merge/dedupe pipelines that keep Salesforce clean at scale.</li> <li><strong>Modelling account hierarchy.</strong> Designing the organisation spine that links accounts to their parent, top operating parent and ultimate corporate parent.</li> <li><strong>Building account sourcing pipelines.</strong> Turning market definitions into ranked, deduplicated, CRM-ready account lists: sourcing from third-party and internal signals, scoring fit, and pushing accounts into Salesforce with the right owner and the right metadata.</li> <li><strong>Building contact sourcing and enrichment pipelines.</strong> Finding the right people at target accounts, verifying and enriching them, respecting privacy and consent requirements, and delivering them into the tools reps and marketers actually work in.</li> <li><strong>Building LLM-powered enrichment.</strong> Extending our enrichment framework — LLM jobs with web search and crawling tools across multiple providers, to answer questions no vendor sells: what support channels does this company run, are they hiring CS or sales roles, do they ship an AI product, how ready are they for Fin.</li> <li><strong>Making the data usable.</strong> Landing everything in well-modelled, well-tested dbt models in Snowflake orchestrated in Airflow, and syncing it out to Salesforce, Marketo, Clay and the rest of the GTM stack.</li> <li><strong>Owning quality and trust.</strong> Instrumenting your pipelines with tests, alerts and reconciliation so problems surface before a rep finds them, and being the person GTM comes to when a number looks wrong.</li> <li><strong>Partnering on the problem, not the ticket.</strong> Sitting with Sales, Marketing and Ops to understand what they are actually trying to do, then proposing the data foundation that unlocks it.</li> </ul> <h2>What skills do I need?</h2> <ul> <li><strong>A genuine interest in growing the business and a real affinity for GTM teams.</strong> You are curious about how sales and marketing work, comfortable in a room full of reps, and motivated by commercial outcomes rather than only technical ones.</li> <li>Experience with the modern data stack: dbt, a cloud warehouse (we use Snowflake), and a DAG orchestrator (we use Airflow).</li> <li>Experience building with LLMs in production: prompt design and evaluation, tool/function calling, web search and crawling, cost and latency control.</li> <li>Experience with entity resolution, identity or deduplication problems — matching messy real-world records, and reasoning about precision/recall trade-offs where a false merge has a real business cost.</li> <li>Hands-on experience integrating with SaaS APIs and business systems, especially Salesforce: reading from them, writing back to them.</li> <li>Strong communication: you can explain a hierarchy change to a CRO and a merge heuristic to an engineer, on the same day.</li> <li>A growth mindset and eagerness to learn — the tooling in this space is changing fast.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to haves</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with GTM data vendors and tooling — ZoomInfo, Apollo, Clearbit, Clay, Crossbeam, Marketo, Census/Fivetran, Gong.</li> <li>Experience with territory design, account scoring, propensity models or ICP definition.</li> <li>Exposure to privacy and compliance considerations around contact data (GDPR, CCPA, consent management).</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Unleash Your Potential</strong></p> <p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.</p> <p>In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at<a href="http://fin.ai/careers"> fin.ai/careers</a>. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. </p> <p><strong>Policies </strong></p> <p>Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.</p> <p>We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our <a href="https://www.intercom.com/careers">core values</a>.  </p> <p>Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal">Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.</a> Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.</p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

IVC Evidensia is undergoing an exciting digital transformation. The key to this is improving the management of our core data sets - accelerating the standardisation of operational systems in practices, building stronger master data management tooling, and developing standard reporting models across the group. As a data engineer, you will work with the team to advance the data platform within a DevOps culture. You will play a central role in building and maintaining scalable data pipelines across Databricks & Azure SQL Server, and will bring solid experience with ELT, orchestration, and scripting languages. A firm grasp of data modelling and management will be essential throughout. The role The Data Engineer will be a technical authority accountable for the design and development of the technologies that underpin our data strategy. At the heart of this is our Databricks data platform, and you will take ownership of building, optimising, and maintaining data pipelines using PySpark - orchestrating feeds from source systems through to our group data platform and taking technical ownership of all parts of the process. You will be working across both our SQL Server environment and our Databricks platform, and an understanding of how the two integrate will be key to success in this role ELT & pipeline development - experience designing and maintaining pipelines using REST APIs, JSON, and ELT protocols Data modelling - comfort working with both relational and non-relational data technologies, with a solid grounding in modelling principles Exposure to business intelligence tools like Power BI is desirable. description: About Allica Bank Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech. Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers. Department Description Allica Bank has won multiple recent Commercial Mortgage awards with the CM products being the main driver of lending in the Allica suite, the Commercial Mortgage products have now been well established for over 2 years and continue to grow at pace as a market leader. As part of the risk function within Commercial Mortgages, this role is critical to ensure we can deliver on our objectives in a safe manner. Role Description The purpose of the role is to underwrite borrowing requests received via a variety of channels, including online in line with the Bank’s approved Credit Policy and in accordance with the Banks asset portfolio (including but not limited to commercial mortgages, commercial investment loans, commercial loans against leasehold properties) . Principle Accountabilities Assess and underwrite direct credit loan applications within personal discretion, in line with the all regulatory requirements, the Bank’s credit appetite policy and underwriting policies utilising appropriate credit data and analytical tools. Produce clear, accurate and concise written documentation, making clear recommendations to the Credit team for loan application requests falling outside of personal discretion or outside of credit policy, escalating cases where necessary to the appropriate Delegated Lending Authorities. Manage and own the end to end application process, from initial enquiry to completion, liaising effectively with the panel solicitors in terms of required security instructions and ensure loans are appropriately documented and borrowing is fully secured before draw-down. Liaise with the Credit team as required in managing the credit risk environment, concentration risk and developing credit policy. Undertake regular checks and monitor agreed controls to ensure the Bank’s risk and customer requirements are met at all times; escalating immediately any areas of concern Manage a portfolio of advances to a defined arrears and collections policy. Liaise effectively with applicants (or their brokers) and valuers in requests for additional relevant information to support the credit decisioning process. Deliver an excellent service is given to customers, their brokers and Relationship Managers, building and maintaining strong relationships in line with the Bank’s values and defined customer experience standards. Ensure compliance with all mandatory policies and adherence to credit procedures to maintain internal credit controls. Fully understand and comply with operational procedures, requirements and SLA’s. Help develop appropriate MI and KPI indicators and reporting, maintaining suitable MI to enable a detailed understanding of Mortgage processing pipeline Actively search for areas of improvement for the Bank and your team and take ownership for delivery of these, setting a good example by displaying appropriate values and behaviour Personal Attributes & Experience Exposure/knowledge of underwriting, with experience in the SME sector, with an understanding of the competitor landscape and the dynamics and trends of the SME market. Excellent credit/financial analysis skills including the analysis of financial accounts, budgets and cashflow forecasting, Understanding of the loan underwriting process and the risks involved and be able to assess applications within a personal discretion and make recommendations and take commercial decisions. Experience of escalating and presenting at Credit Committee level and Arrears Management. Strong analytical, verbal and written communication skills. Ability to build strong and lasting relationships with internal stakeholders such as the distribution team, operations team and senior management, plus 3rd party suppliers such as Intermediaries, Valuers and Solicitors. Understand and comply with all regulatory requirements, plus internal policies / procedures, guidelines, risks and controls and service levels. Good understanding of TCF, AML, KYC and Conduct risk. Working at Allica Bank At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers. Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind: Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities Options for flexible working Regular social activities Pension contributions Discretionary bonus scheme Private health cover Life assurance Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave Don’t tick every box? Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you! Flexible working We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate. Diversity We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

You’ll work across teams to deliver features, services and integrations that make running a business simpler from invoicing and expenses to payments and automation.</li> </ul> <p>Both roles have a wide remit and involve working across engineering, product and other teams at Monzo. They'll be your partner and guide throughout the interview process.</li> <li><strong>Initial Call (45 mins)</strong> You'll meet with one of our engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular program execution and technical leadership. They’ll also make time to tell you about Monzo and answer your questions.</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage (3 hours)</strong> The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability).</li> </ol> <p>All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process. If you’d like to ask a question sooner, email <a href="mailto:tech-hiring@monzo.com">tech-hiring@monzo.com</a></p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰Base salary range for this role is dependent on experience + equity + stock options & benefits</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong>here</strong></a></p> <p>#LI-SS1</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. The team is responsible for understanding our prudential regulatory reporting requirements, working on projects and submissions relating to these and collaborating with teams across Monzo.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Producing Monzo’s regulatory liquidity reporting, ensuring robust and consistent controls across all outputs to support regulatory compliance and internal governance requirements</li> <li>Documenting the applicable regulatory interpretations and communication</li> <li>Assisting the wider team produce Monzo’s capital and liquidity regulatory reporting and disclosures (including Pillar 3)</li> <li>Executing and improving the controls required to ensure regulatory reporting is timely, accurate and complete</li> <li>Ensuring all our regulatory reporting runs like clockwork</li> <li>Using data visualisation tools to build dashboards and facilitate sign-off and useful insights</li> <li>Designing brilliant ways to automate your work and leverage technology to ensure we scale with the business</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a good understanding and experience of producing LCR, NSFR, PRA110, ALMM returns</li> <li>You’re excited by data and have a sharp eye for detail</li> <li>You have knowledge of coding languages like SQL would be a bonus, although a willingness to learn is just fine </li> <li>You have a proven record of delivering to strict deadlines </li> <li>You want to automate or enhance recurring processes, particularly by leveraging technology, but know how to balance this with getting the actual reports out!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰up to £55,000 (depending on experience) ➕ incentive awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role is based in our London office on a hybrid basis. We expect 1 - 2 days per week working from the office.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 £200 allowance to spend on your work-from-home setup after completing your first full month with us.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Phone call with recruiter (30 mins)</li> <li>Initial call with hiring manager (30 mins)</li> <li>Technical interview with hiring manager and team member (45 mins)</li> <li>Monzo behavioural interview (30 min)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! <br><br>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-NZ1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Head of Financial Planning & Analysis
location: Home Based - Americas; Home based - EMEA; Office Based - London, UK
description: <p>We are hiring for the <strong>Head of Financial Planning & Analysis</strong>, to lead the global FP&A Teams and be a leader within the wider finance team. You will play a key part leading our monthly business reviews and forecasting, annual planning, and continuously drive cross-functional business alignment, as well as develop the long term roadmap for the FP&A team. Our ideal candidate is a highly analytical independent thinker, who has a proven record of leading a team to use data analysis to advise on critical financial, commercial and strategic decisions.</p> <p>Our business opportunity is significant; we can deliver both infrastructure and business applications to the enterprise market. As companies refresh their data centers, our goal is to be the platform for cloud and apps. As they re-architect their business applications to embrace open source, our goal is to deliver the majority of their databases, analytics, messaging, publishing, identity, security, workflow... everything that is open source. We are committed to do that at the most efficient price points possible to drive down the total cost of IT, but this is nevertheless a significant global market, and our ambition is to be counted among the most valued software suppliers to the Global 10,000.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This is a remote role in AMER or EMEA time zones, with the option to be based in our London office.</p> <h3>The role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Develop executive reporting dashboards and documents including Board reporting, monthly financial results and other management presentations</li> <li>Analyse & Report monthly results, leading indicators and KPIs to support monthly forecasting and annual plan attainment</li> <li>Provide commercial analysis, develop growth targets, and evaluate strategic initiatives</li> <li>Work with product managers to produce, aggregate, and distribute both market insights and competitive intelligence</li> <li>Manage financial models, including budgeting, forecasting, and long range planning</li> <li>Drive improvements in data analysis, and determine the appropriate processes, methodologies, and modeling techniques to deliver insights.</li> <li>Partner with Accounting and Investor Relations to support month end close, flux review processes, and financial reporting</li> <li>Drive multi-functional change projects designed to enhance systems, processes, and data accuracy</li> <li>Play a key role in preparation of critical public financial documents to support an IPO process, including supporting the production of investor materials and public filings</li> <li>Guide the annual FP&A activity calendar to provide decision support to the executive team</li> <li>Mentor colleagues within the FP&A team, as well as peer teams</li> <li>Control costs via methodical reviews of department spend, procurement strategies, and business wide process efficiency</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record</li> <li>Experience and a deeply rooted passion to lead successful team members, and aid in their career growth </li> <li>Have operated in a high growth, multi currency/geography technology business with a mixed go-to-market motion</li> <li>Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities</li> <li>Highest ethical standards, integrity, authenticity, credibility, and character</li> <li>Curiosity and willingness to work on a wide range of projects</li> <li>Proficiency in spreadsheets, financial modeling, and BI tools</li> <li>Understanding of core accounting principles </li> <li>Professional written and spoken English </li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability </li> <li>Passionate, thoughtful, and self-motivated</li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet and exceed commitments </li> <li>International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3>Nice-to-have skills</h3> <ul> <li>MBA or equivalent combination of professional certifications and experience</li> <li>Previous experience as a subject matter expert in Financial Planning & Analysis</li> <li>Experience with Business Intelligence reporting, CRM and ERP systems</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review</li> <li>Company recognition rewards</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Spanish -Speaking  - London, UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Pallet </strong></p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy — a $12 trillion global industry. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. In under two years, we’ve achieved 700% revenue growth and are just getting started.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down — from scheduling and appointment setting to data entry and load management. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, control, and optimization, while our newest product, CoPallet, introduces AI Agents that can understand and execute requests in real time and integrate directly with customer systems.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">As companies across the physical economy look to generative AI to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.</p> <p>Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.</p></div><p><strong>London, United Kingdom or Zurich, Switzerland (Remote to start, transitioning to 5 days/week in-office once our local office opens)</strong></p> <p><strong>You could be an Enterprise Account Executive anywhere. Why us?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.</li> <li>Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.</li> <li>Build Pallet’s presence across Europe as one of the first commercial hires on the ground.</li> <li>Work directly with founders and senior leadership to define our international go-to-market strategy.</li> <li>Help transform one of the world’s largest industries while building toward a $10B+ outcome.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the opportunity</strong></p> <p>We’re hiring our first Enterprise Account Executives in EMEA to build Pallet’s commercial presence across Europe.</p> <p>You’ll own net-new enterprise acquisition across the region, build relationships with the largest logistics providers in Europe, and help establish the playbook for our international expansion. This is a highly consultative enterprise sales role focused on educating customers on an entirely new category of AI-powered workflow automation.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to drive a solution-selling motion centered around workflow discovery, AI use case identification, structured pilots, and measurable ROI.</p> <p>Initially, this role will be remote from London while we establish our UK presence. Once our London office opens, this role will transition to working from the office five days per week when not traveling to customer sites.</p> <p><strong>How you will make an impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the full enterprise sales cycle across EMEA, from outbound prospecting through contract signature.</li> <li>Build and maintain a 3x-4x qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound execution while self-sourcing at least 30% of opportunities.</li> <li>Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Europe’s largest logistics providers, including COO, CIO, VP Operations, VP Supply Chain, and VP Technology.</li> <li>Lead consultative discovery sessions that map operational workflows to Pallet’s AI agent capabilities.</li> <li>Scope and lead structured pilots that demonstrate measurable operational ROI and convert into enterprise deployments.</li> <li>Build executive business cases that align operational improvements with financial outcomes.</li> <li>Document repeatable customer use cases and market feedback to shape Pallet’s product roadmap and international GTM strategy.</li> <li>Help establish Pallet as the leading AI platform for enterprise logistics across Europe.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS or enterprise logistics sales experience.</li> <li>Business-fluent Spanish you can run discovery, negotiate and present to executives in Spanish. </li> <li>Proven track record of consistently closing six- and seven-figure enterprise software agreements.</li> <li>Strong consultative selling and value-based sales methodology.</li> <li>Experience navigating complex buying committees and long enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Executive presence with senior operators and technology leaders.</li> <li>Comfortable selling technical, workflow-heavy software products.</li> <li>Ability to quickly understand complex logistics operations and translate them into compelling AI automation opportunities.</li> <li>Excellent outbound prospecting and territory-building discipline.</li> <li>Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.</li> </ul> <p>Experience selling into logistics, supply chain, transportation, or warehouse operations is strongly preferred but not required. Candidates without logistics experience should demonstrate an ability to quickly learn operational workflows and become trusted advisors to customers.</p> <p><strong>Working model</strong></p> <p>Working hours are generally <strong>9:00am-6:00pm London time</strong>, providing full coverage of the European business day while maintaining regular collaboration with our San Francisco headquarters.</p> <p>You’ll typically spend:</p> <ul> <li>Mornings and early afternoons working directly with European customers and prospects.</li> <li>Late afternoons collaborating with our US-based Sales, Product, and Engineering teams during our daily overlap window.</li> <li>Approximately 75% of your time traveling across Europe for customer meetings, executive workshops, pilots, and industry events.</li> </ul> <p>Initially this role will be remote. Once Pallet opens its local office, you’ll work from the office five days per week whenever you’re not traveling to customers.</p> <p><strong>Reporting structure</strong></p> <p>You’ll report directly to the <strong>General Manager, London</strong> for territory strategy, customer relationships, and international expansion.</p> <p>You’ll also work closely with our <strong>Head of Sales</strong>, participating in weekly pipeline reviews, forecasting, and sales process alignment with the US team.</p> <p><strong>Interview Process</strong></p> <ul> <li>Chat with Christy - Business Recruiter - 30 mins</li> <li>Deal Review - 30 mins</li> <li>Discovery Mock Interview - 45-60 mins</li> <li>Final Interview - ~3 hours</li> <li>Brief Background Check and Reference Check</li> </ul> <p>We move fast, and we’ll keep you informed at every stage of the process.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>The estimated compensation range for this role is <strong>£100,000-£240,000 OTE</strong>, depending on experience and skill set.</p> <p>Our compensation follows a standard 50/50 enterprise sales structure consisting of base salary and target commission. High performers are eligible for uncapped commission accelerators above quota.</p> <p>In addition to cash compensation, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and significant growth opportunities as one of our earliest international commercial hires.</p> <p>Final compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated enterprise sales performance.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Benefits </strong></p> <p>We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously.</p> <ul> <li>🩺 Health, Vision, and Dental benefits </li> <li>🏝️ Take-what-you-need Paid Vacation</li> <li>➕ Life Insurance and Accidental Insurance </li> <li>❤️‍🩹 Short-Term Disability Coverage</li> <li>💸 Generous salary and equity for all staff</li> <li>🪜 401k option; helping you save for the future</li> <li>🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Paid parental leave to support growing families</li> <li>📚 Yearly learning and development stipend</li> <li>🚌 Commuter benefits for Bay Area employees</li> <li>🚘 Uber ride stipend if you ever have to work late in the office </li> <li>🏡 Remote office home stipend to get you comfy in your space</li> <li>🍔 Daily catered lunches provided </li> <li>✈️ Onboarding trip to San Francisco HQ if you work remotely</li> <li>🥤 Monthly happy hours</li> <li>🎉 Annual Company Offsites; our last one was in Palm Springs CA 🌴</li> </ul> <p><strong>Workplace Policy</strong></p> <p>We are an in-person company. Our offices in San Francisco, New York City and London are where ideas get built, decisions get made, and the team gets stronger. We have invested in making them genuinely great places to spend your day, with catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and people who care about the work and each other.</p> <p>Most of our team works in office five days a week. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip. </p> <p>Every role is different. Travel expectations are always shared upfront in the job description and confirmed in your first call with us.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity</strong></p> <p>Pallet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, disability status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We prohibit any form of discrimination or harassment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring.</p> <p><strong>Candidate Privacy Notice</strong></p> <p>Please review Pallet’s Candidate Privacy Notice <a href="https://pallet.com/privacy">here</a>.</p> <p><strong>Accommodations</strong></p> <p>Pallet complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended by the ADA Amendments Act, and all applicable state or local laws. We will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with a disability during the application process and throughout employment as required by law.</p> <p>If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please contact us at <strong

title: Enterprise Account Executive - German-Speaking
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Pallet </strong></p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy — a $12 trillion global industry. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. In under two years, we’ve achieved 700% revenue growth and are just getting started.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down — from scheduling and appointment setting to data entry and load management. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, control, and optimization, while our newest product, CoPallet, introduces AI Agents that can understand and execute requests in real time and integrate directly with customer systems.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">As companies across the physical economy look to generative AI to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.</p> <p>Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.</p></div><p><strong>London, United Kingdom or Switzerland (Remote to start, transitioning to 5 days/week in-office in London or Zurich)</strong></p> <p><strong>You could be an Enterprise Account Executive anywhere. Why us?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.</li> <li>Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.</li> <li>Build Pallet’s presence across Europe as one of the first commercial hires on the ground.</li> <li>Work directly with founders and senior leadership to define our international go-to-market strategy.</li> <li>Help transform one of the world’s largest industries while building toward a $10B+ outcome.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the opportunity</strong></p> <p>We’re hiring our first Enterprise Account Executives in EMEA to build Pallet’s commercial presence across Europe.</p> <p>You’ll own net-new enterprise acquisition across the region, build relationships with the largest logistics providers in Europe, and help establish the playbook for our international expansion. This is a highly consultative enterprise sales role focused on educating customers on an entirely new category of AI-powered workflow automation.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to drive a solution-selling motion centered around workflow discovery, AI use case identification, structured pilots, and measurable ROI.</p> <p>Initially, this role will be remote from London while we establish our UK presence. Once our London office opens, this role will transition to working from the office five days per week when not traveling to customer sites.</p> <p><strong>How you will make an impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the full enterprise sales cycle across EMEA, from outbound prospecting through contract signature.</li> <li>Build and maintain a 3x-4x qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound execution while self-sourcing at least 30% of opportunities.</li> <li>Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Europe’s largest logistics providers, including COO, CIO, VP Operations, VP Supply Chain, and VP Technology.</li> <li>Lead consultative discovery sessions that map operational workflows to Pallet’s AI agent capabilities.</li> <li>Scope and lead structured pilots that demonstrate measurable operational ROI and convert into enterprise deployments.</li> <li>Build executive business cases that align operational improvements with financial outcomes.</li> <li>Document repeatable customer use cases and market feedback to shape Pallet’s product roadmap and international GTM strategy.</li> <li>Help establish Pallet as the leading AI platform for enterprise logistics across Europe.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS or enterprise logistics sales experience.</li> <li>Business-fluent German: you can run discovery, negotiate and present to executives in German. </li> <li>Proven track record of consistently closing six- and seven-figure enterprise software agreements.</li> <li>Strong consultative selling and value-based sales methodology.</li> <li>Experience navigating complex buying committees and long enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Executive presence with senior operators and technology leaders.</li> <li>Comfortable selling technical, workflow-heavy software products.</li> <li>Ability to quickly understand complex logistics operations and translate them into compelling AI automation opportunities.</li> <li>Excellent outbound prospecting and territory-building discipline.</li> <li>Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.</li> </ul> <p>Experience selling into logistics, supply chain, transportation, or warehouse operations is strongly preferred but not required. Candidates without logistics experience should demonstrate an ability to quickly learn operational workflows and become trusted advisors to customers.</p> <p><strong>Working model</strong></p> <p>Working hours are generally <strong>9:00am-6:00pm London time</strong>, providing full coverage of the European business day while maintaining regular collaboration with our San Francisco headquarters.</p> <p>You’ll typically spend:</p> <ul> <li>Mornings and early afternoons working directly with European customers and prospects.</li> <li>Late afternoons collaborating with our US-based Sales, Product, and Engineering teams during our daily overlap window.</li> <li>Approximately 75% of your time traveling across Europe for customer meetings, executive workshops, pilots, and industry events.</li> </ul> <p>Initially this role will be remote from London. Once Pallet opens its London office, you’ll work from the office five days per week whenever you’re not traveling to customers.</p> <p><strong>Reporting structure</strong></p> <p>You’ll report directly to the <strong>General Manager, London</strong> for territory strategy, customer relationships, and international expansion.</p> <p>You’ll also work closely with our <strong>Head of Sales</strong>, participating in weekly pipeline reviews, forecasting, and sales process alignment with the US team.</p> <p><strong>Interview Process</strong></p> <ul> <li>Chat with Christy - Business Recruiter - 30 mins</li> <li>Deal Review - 30 mins</li> <li>Discovery Mock Interview - 45-60 mins</li> <li>Final Interview - ~3 hours</li> <li>Brief Background Check and Reference Check</li> </ul> <p>We move fast, and we’ll keep you informed at every stage of the process.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>The estimated compensation range for this role is <strong>£100,000-£240,000 OTE</strong>, depending on experience and skill set.</p> <p>Our compensation follows a standard 50/50 enterprise sales structure consisting of base salary and target commission. High performers are eligible for uncapped commission accelerators above quota.</p> <p>In addition to cash compensation, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and significant growth opportunities as one of our earliest international commercial hires.</p> <p>Final compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated enterprise sales performance.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Benefits </strong></p> <p>We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously.</p> <ul> <li>🩺 Health, Vision, and Dental benefits </li> <li>🏝️ Take-what-you-need Paid Vacation</li> <li>➕ Life Insurance and Accidental Insurance </li> <li>❤️‍🩹 Short-Term Disability Coverage</li> <li>💸 Generous salary and equity for all staff</li> <li>🪜 401k option; helping you save for the future</li> <li>🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Paid parental leave to support growing families</li> <li>📚 Yearly learning and development stipend</li> <li>🚌 Commuter benefits for Bay Area employees</li> <li>🚘 Uber ride stipend if you ever have to work late in the office </li> <li>🏡 Remote office home stipend to get you comfy in your space</li> <li>🍔 Daily catered lunches provided </li> <li>✈️ Onboarding trip to San Francisco HQ if you work remotely</li> <li>🥤 Monthly happy hours</li> <li>🎉 Annual Company Offsites; our last one was in Palm Springs CA 🌴</li> </ul> <p><strong>Workplace Policy</strong></p> <p>We are an in-person company. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip. </p> <p>Every role is different.
